package_format.body: exact canonical manifest bytes then additional_objects values as raw bytes, ordered by lowercase SHA-256 key; no compression, padding, executable metadata or trailer
package_format.member_destination_rule: objects/<sha256> for materialized unique regular bytes; logical evidence aliases remain manifest mappings
package_format.name: OHK-RETENTION-1
package_format.object_offset_rule: 32 + manifest_bytes + sum(bytes of lexicographically earlier additional_objects)

recovery_destination_rule: For each member source PREFIX:REL, exact destination is evidence/PREFIX/REL. Source locator is source_prefixes[PREFIX] + /REL. Metadata-only members are never instantiated as symlinks or special files.

roles.0: accepted application and historical recovery evidence
roles.2: campaign authority, harness or adverse-history dependency

additional_payload_triage.scope: 3,688 additional raw payload blobs; ZIP provider expansion is covered by archive_screen

screening.limitations: Pattern triage over selected raw files, decoded diagnostics and 16 archive providers including nested ZIPs; not a credential-free or publication-rights warranty. Host locators and fixture attestations remain disclosed. Interpreter/dependency bytes are excluded.

verification.authority_warning: Integrity and historical fixture permission recovery do not issue authority. Expected-negative fixture bundles are not required to pass valid-bundle checks.
